_knownIssue: Each generated CRUD endpoint (create-/get-/update-/list-{entity}) keeps its own separate field-projection config in the console — they don't share one source of truth. generatedhtml's get-generatedhtml Default view was found with stale projection names (htmlcontent, projectId) that didn't match the real columns (html_content, project_id), silently returning nulls with no error. Confirmed fixed for generatedhtml. Check the same get-*/list-* projection screens for script, voiceover, and finalvideo before relying on their responses — they were scaffolded the same way at the same time and likely have the same stale names.
_liveConfirmed: CONFIRMED LIVE as of 2026-08-10 via describe_entity — all 15 fields below (including video_type/canvas/director/cursor_speed) and the updated status enum are on the real entity now. Got here by deleting and recreating (there was no MCP update_entity/delete_entity path, and no live data existed yet to lose) via create_entity. One thing to flag for next time: create_entity's ownerIndexes param isn't in its declared schema (entityName/UpdateParams/baseKeys/entityIdFieldName/IndexFields/Views/PublicOperations only) — passing it anyway got silently accepted (additionalProperties:true) but stored as a raw stringified blob instead of structured config, which silently broke owner-scoping (no user_id auto-stamp, no working by-owner index) until fixed manually in the console. Re-verified via describe_entity afterward: ownerIndexes came back as a real array again. If recreating any other entity that needs owner-scoping, set the owner index in the console after create_entity, not by passing ownerIndexes to the tool call.

additionalParams.name: status

Same per-endpoint propagation caveat as before (#13/#20/#21b) — update enumValues on create/get/list/update endpoints individually.
